name: renpy-ios
notes: F-105 stage B. RenPyLGPL.xcframework: the LGPL parts of Ren'Py 8.5.3 as ONE separate, relinkable dynamic framework (iphoneos arm64 + iphonesimulator arm64, MH_DYLIB, no x86_64). Built FROM SOURCE by tools/renpy/build-lgpl.sh (make renpy-lgpl); inputs pinned with sha256 in tools/renpy/inputs.lock; BUILD-INPUTS.sha256 is the build stamp. SDL2 symbols are imported from @rpath/SDL2.framework/SDL2 (zlib, embedded by the app later). Relink instructions: docs/legal/renpy-lgpl-compliance.md.

renpyBuild.used: patches/ffmpeg-4.3.1-sse.diff, patches/ffmpeg-4.3.1-ff_seek_frame_binary.diff, FFmpeg configure flags of tasks/ffmpeg.py

libaom.notes: AV1 decoder only, linked statically inside RenPyLGPL; also under the AOM Patent License 1.0 (text in LICENSE).

SDL2.notes: headers only (compile alphablit.c / SDL_gfxPrimitives.c); no SDL code is inside RenPyLGPL
